description: Screenshot of a Q drop dated 9 Jul 2019, 2:17:37 AM (tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI) whose content is a satirical image of a cinema 'Now Playing' marquee holding three fake movie posters. Screen 4 shows a parody of the Guardians of the Galaxy poster retitled 'Guardians of the Pedophiles'; screen 5 shows a 'Panic in DC' poster with the U.S. Capitol skyline and the Q line 'They never thought she would lose'; screen 6 shows a 'FISAGATE' poster depicting Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, Andrew McCabe, James Comey and Loretta Lynch with review-style quotes attributed to Reps. Mark Meadows, Jim Jordan, Matt Gaetz, Steve King and Scott Perry. Whether the marquee is a real installation or a photoshop is not established.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI. 9 Jul 2019 - 2:17:37 AM. NOW PLAYING. 4. 5. 6. GUARDIANS OF THE PEDOPHILES. "THEY NEVER THOUGHT SHE WOULD LOSE" -Q. PANIC IN DC. IN THEATERS NOW. FISAGATE. Mark Meadows. "It is so alarming the American people have to see this" Jim Jordan. "There has been a real attempt to undermine this President & it comes from the highest of places" Matt Gaetz. "The sickening reality has set in. I no longer hold out hope there is an innocent explanation for the information the public has seen" Steve King. "As soon as you read the memo, you think, is this happening in America or is this the KGB?" Scott Perry.
flags: Satirical/meme posters presenting political accusations ('Pedophiles', 'FISAGATE') as movie titles - claims documented, not endorsed.
Fine-print quote attributed to Mark Meadows is too small to read fully; other small quotes transcribed best-effort.
Marquee may be a photoshop rather than a real theater display; unverified.

description: Screenshot of Q drop #2297, dated Sep 29 2018 15:04:05 (EST), tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, post No. 308, with the date 'Sep 29 2018' added as a header above the capture. GOOG - FB will follow. EXPECT COMMS BLACKOUT ATTEMPT (POTUS TWITTER) [ROGUE_EMPLOYEE_EXCUSE]. Welcome to the POLICE STATE. THEY KNOW IF THEY LOSE IT'S OVER. THE TIME TO FIGHT!!!!!!!! IS NOW. GOOD V EVIL. HUMANITY IS AT STAKE. DROP THE MEMES. SILENT MAJORITY NO MORE. BE LOUD - YOU HAVE A VOICE. ARE YOU REGISTERED?. VOTE THEM ALL OUT. PREPARE. RED OCTOBER. WE STAND TOGETHER. Q
